Author: deserokk
Name: DeserokUtils
Description:
A small personal set of utilities. /dsu opens the window.

CastWatch: a consistent way to announce spells.
Mouseover: mouseover macros in one line, with a fallback.
FateWatch: a timer for FATEs that run on a cycle.
FcBuffs: keeps the Free Company buffs topped up.
DrawSheathe: a draw/sheathe key that incorporates the Gold Saucer emotes.
EmoteQuiet: stops emote spam in your log.
Interact: an interact key that ignores open menus and advances dialogue.
EphemeralMarks: private markers for the people you queued in with.
DebuffMarks: a private icon over anyone with a debuff you name.
AchievementData: makes achievement links in chat work.
PartyJobs: shows the job of party members who are not in your zone.
Keybinds: bind these to a key instead of a hotbar macro.

Author: deserokk
Name: Fanfare
Description:
Changes achievement notifications to a stylized, console-adjacent popup with definable sounds.
Six chimes are included; point it at your own file in the settings.
Punchline: Achievements deserve better than a line of chat text
